answer: Because the glacier cliff is fixed at deposit and logged in the relic ledger, the ledge audit shows how much each key had accrued when it was cut. Nothing unlocks before a cliff of 12 epochs, and a slash during the cliff forfeits the entire grant rather than the vested portion. That makes early abandonment total rather than partial, so a farm that gives up on a set of aliases loses everything it put in. A farm of 255 pays that 293 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
